about: Literature Galaxy, public background copy. Positions, group colours, approved topic names and links only; titles, authors and years are left blank until they have been checked.

fields.groups: [approved topic name, colour, items, kind]; kind 1 = files whose text could not be read (unnamed)
fields.nodes: [x, y, z, g (group), year (0), first author (blank), title (blank)]
fields.nb: each item's k nearest neighbours (node indices), most similar first, items in node order (item i's list is nb[i*k .. i*k+k-1]); every pair is one link, drawn in the colour of the item whose list names it first
fields.flow: for each item, how fast light runs from it along its strongest link (to nb[i*k]): 0.6 + flow/10 trips per 9 seconds
